item.description: After documenting her weight loss with semaglutide, followed by weight gain after going off the expensive drug, Marion Winik has re-lost the pounds with the help of a less expensive, gray-market version of retatrutide.

item.title: Top 5 Stories This Morning: John Waters Wedding, Animal Dung, Super Bowl Artifacts, and more.
item.description: Last week, we shared news about an auction item for John Waters to officiate your wedding; an offer to name animal dung after your ex; and Second Chance emporium finds that serve as reminders of the Baltimore Ravens' first Super Bowl victory 25 years ago.

item.title: Maryland’s price gouging law went into effect but who did it protect?
item.description: Ahead of the recent winter storm, Gov. Wes Moore declared a state of emergency, which activated Maryland’s price gouging law. However, the order did not specify which items are considered essential.

item.title: Urban Landscape: Bringing long-dormant spaces back to life was the recurring theme of 2025 and will continue in 2026
item.description: Both the past year on Baltimore’s urban landscape front, and the year ahead, might best be summed up by one recurring theme: the activation of long-dormant places and spaces that were waiting to be rediscovered and brought back to life.
